description: Released approval templates (arch doc 5.1, M12). A released template is never edited in place: scripts/validate-approval-matrix-source.ps1 fails one whose fingerprint no longer matches, so the one change it may undergo is deactivation. A change is a new version, <name>_v2, released here beside it, with the rules repointed and the previous version deactivated. To release a template, add the line the gate prints for it. Never edit a fingerprint.
fingerprint: SHA-256 of the template's XML with its <active> element removed, insignificant whitespace dropped and line endings normalised, as Get-TemplateFingerprint computes it. Source is in the form a retrieve returns, so a retrieve does not disturb it.
